title: Evidence-first literature research with literature map
description: Requires parallel native websearch/webfetch plus arc_search_literature retrieval, explicit rejection filtering, staged pauses in gradual mode, targeted checks before each idea, and a user-facing literature map over accepted papers.
changes: Add evidence discipline rules: no empty-search novelty claims and no single-source conclusions.
Require parallel retrieval with native websearch/webfetch and arc_search_literature for literature research.
Require paper_cards.jsonl and rejected_papers.jsonl with relevance filtering.
Add literature_map.md for cluster, lineage, overlap, coverage, limitations, and improvement-space views.
Add targeted existence checks and cost estimates before presenting each idea.
Strengthen gradual/stepwise pause points so the agent does not cross phases without user approval.

rollback.notes: Restore the previous synthesis-boundary-only literature-research workflow.
